notes.title: [v1.2 Refactor Update] "Bug Clearing Plan" & New Discounts Available Now!
notes.content: [p][b]Hello to all new and existing employees of Mat-Rix![/b][/p][p][/p][p]Our company’s [b]Shrink Rooms[/b] has finally completed development after undergoing bottom-up refactoring. Its overall operational stability and reliability have been significantly improved, and we believe it will help us identify the most top-tier employees![/p][p][/p][p]We welcome you to continue submitting your resumes and participating in Mat-Rix’s recruitment test![/p][p][/p][p]Additionally, [b]Shrink Rooms[/b] is offering a limited-time 2-week all-time low [b]20%[/b] discount. Now, you can participate in the application with an entry fee of only [b]$11.99[/b]![/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3409430/_/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]The key updates from this large-scale refactoring are as follows:[/p][p][/p][h2]💥New Content:[/h2][list][*][p][b]Inverter floor tiles[/b] have been replaced with [b]Inverter Pressure Plates[/b] (yellow = on, red = off).[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45416319/0f819993c956e334a30d7a8f04ceb16de1540b72.gif"][/img][/p][/*][*][p]Visual optimization of [b]Signal Lines[/b] to enhance dynamic prompt effects.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45416319/c625d2dab3f7ca5733c68e24f758d5e8d0d74a81.gif"][/img][/p][/*][*][p]Optimized the color and animation of the [b]prompt dashed lines[/b] on obscured Pressure Plates, making it easier for players to locate Pressure Plates hidden by obstacles.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45416319/d1f116ad62e20f8083c3fd6de78d72834ee9a59a.gif"][/img][/p][/*][*][p]Completed refactoring of underlying code, significantly reducing bugs in complex levels involving [b]Polymers, Portals[/b], etc. ([b][i][u]If you encounter any, please give feedback to Mat-Rix’s Discord[/u][/i][/b]).[/p][p][/p][/*][*][p]Completed localization proofreading for the [b]Japanese[/b] version.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h2]💦Level Adjustments:[/h2][list][*][p]Removed some levels that were inconsistent with the mechanics of preceding and following levels and had jarring difficulty jumps, including: 1-13, 1-38, 1-40, etc.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed unintended solutions for some levels, including: 1-18, 3-45, C-07, 4-36, E-05, E-16, etc.[/p][/*][*][p]Redesigned levels A-05, A-06, and B-04 while preserving their core reasoning logic.[/p][p][/p][carousel autoadvance="true"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45416319/2002f1dca95e35ca896d60bff0b6188924a8ed60.gif"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45416319/7e15e085b49d04cd5cf7ed294b1ff26470eb00a5.gif"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45416319/0e850ecfab756dfad427c91d469b7f17fa5e5f41.gif"][/img][/carousel][/*][*][p]Optimized the reasoning experience of numerous levels by making some incorrect solutions more obvious, including: 1-9, 2-47, C-05, D-05, 4-37, 5-24, 5-25, 5-29, 5-33, and 5-35, etc.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45416319/af675b6e43d7fe4797b31b254f6bdbee043cabc3.gif"][/img][/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted the positions of portals around level 3-65 in the chapter 3 level selection map.[/p][/*][*][p]Added 1 new side level at the end of the C-07 level sequence.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h2]💢Bugfixes & Optimizations:[/h2][list][*][p]The game now correctly handles multi-polymer consumption issues when passing through portals under specific circumstances.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the error where players couldn’t move when a pair of portals were in adjacent corners.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed some polymer breakage errors in complex structures.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the issue where the game incorrectly played a death animation if the player was in a pit after undoing an action.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed undo errors involving multi-polymer consumption that affects structures.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the breakage error when boxes are stuck on inactive portals.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the error where wires turn green after pressure plates connected to NOT gates are destroyed.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed logic errors in complex scenarios involving portals, multi-polymer consumption, and polymer breakage.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the issue where "self-sticking" was incorrectly triggered.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the error where pushing boxes triggers polymer consumption when portals and multiple polymers are adjacent.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the error where linked structures are incorrectly destroyed when walls push players and box-sticking structures.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed polymer breakage logic errors when complex structures move due to multi-polymer consumption.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed polymer breakage logic errors when players stick to complex structures and move toward walls.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed logic errors when players stick to complex structures and move toward adjacent corner portals.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed logic errors when structures move toward portals due to multi-polymer consumption.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed incorrect polymer structure breakage when boxes are crushed.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the error where players overlap with walls if players and boxes are not pushed correctly during the same wall movement.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the missing sound effect when walls are blocked by anchor boxes.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]If you encounter other issues, feel free to join our Discord: [url="https://discord.gg/vNq3vMuBMw"]https://discord.gg/vNq3vMuBMw[/url] to provide feedback![/p][p][/p][p]In addition, Shrink Rooms has joined the East Asia Indie Games Celebration! Please vote for Shrink Rooms on this page: [/p][p][url="https://eaigc.filtergame.com/GameVote"]https://eaigc.filtergame.com/GameVote[/url]! Participation enters you into a Steam Key giveaway![/p][p][/p][p]Mat-Rix[/p][p][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: 2025 v1.1.3 Updated Note
notes.content:
[h1]Content Update[/h1]
[list]
[*] Several main levels have been added to the fourth area of Chapter Three, and the difficulty curve has been adjusted.
[*] Level 2 - 48 has been adjusted to a side - level, and a new main level has been added to this sequence.
[*] Level 3 - 34 has been adjusted to a side - level.
[*] Level optimization (Levels 3 - 51, 3 - 61, 3 - 48, 3 - 58, 3 - 59)
[*] Level 5 - 20 has been adjusted to a side - level.
[/list]
[h1]Experience Optimization[/h1]
[list]
[*] After the player dies, the level will no longer be automatically reset. You can choose to manually reset or undo the last step.
[/list]
[h1]Problem Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] The polymer blocks in the cave will no longer be consumed and create new connections.
[*] The number of the disappeared Level 2 - 07 is back!
[*] Fixed the localization and interaction issues on the level completion screen in some languages.
[*] The achievements for [b]Inspect all exhibits[/b], [b]Complete Chapter 5[/b], and [b]Complete the Game[/b] can now be normally unlocked.
[*] The unintended solutions of the following levels have been fixed. Welcome to continue the challenge! —— A - 05, 2 - 13, 2 - 18, 2 - 33, 2 - 45, B - 03, B - 05, B - 09, 3 - 48, 4 - 19, 4 - 22, E - 06, E - 10
[/list]

notes.title: "Wall-tastic"! Shrink Rooms LAUNCH DATE & PRICE Revealed🎮
notes.content:
[b]Dear puzzle lovers,
Programmers are losing hair, the art team is exhausted from revisions, and the planners are laughing at bugs.
Yes,[/b]
[h2] [b]Shrink Rooms Will Be Available On Steam On May 28th[/b]![/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45416319/1f9fe414d458a19aeb139386c8b2f6b836428bb9.png[/img]

The original price is [b]$14.99[/b] , with [b]15% off[/b] and a [b]10% off[/b] in bundles for the [b]first 12 days[/b]. [b]Add to your Wishlist now[/b], and you'll be notified as soon as it's on sale!

[h3]Full version compared to the demo:  [/h3]
- A bunch of new levels.  
- Super refined graphics and interface.  
- Added a few pages of comic storyline (the story is a bit lame, but better than nothing).

The level editor is delayed. To make up for it, we're launching a [b]Community Level Contest[/b]: design a super hard level, and your name will be in the game.

Click the link or join our [url=https://discord.gg/vNq3vMuBMw]Discord[/url] for submission methods and design tips. Hint: the harder, the better!
